how: Each page fetched directly from Lucid's help center (support.lucidtrading.com, HTTP 200). lucidtrading.com itself returns 403 to our reader, so the price is UNVERIFIED. Quotes are short excerpts.

mll.quote: End of Day Drawdown... calculates the account's highest closing balance

lock.note: the MLL locks at start + $100 ($50,100) once the balance passes $52,100
lock.quote: the MLL locks at the initial balance plus $100

dll.option: DLL ON (picked at checkout, never changeable)
dll.breach: soft: no more trades until the next session; the account is not failed
dll.quote: If you reach the DLL... restricted from placing additional trades until the next trading session

dll_off.quote: No Daily Loss Limit is applied during either the evaluation or funded phase

consistency.note: NOT FOUND for the evaluation (the 40% rule is a funded payout rule)

time_limit.quote: take as long as you need to pass

mll.quote: Once your account exceeds the Initial Trail Balance, the MLL locks and no longer moves

dll.scaling: above $52,100 the LucidScale DLL = 60% of the highest end-of-day profit (the funded table says '60% of Peak EOD Balance': the two pages word it differently)
dll.quote: Highest end-of-day account profit × 60% = LucidScale DLL

consistency.applies: payouts; resets after each payout; accounts bought or reset on or after 2025-11-28 15:00 EST (older: 35%)
consistency.quote: must meet a Consistency Percentage of 40%

max_micros.quote: No scaling plan, access to max contract size immediately

split.quote: All funded account payouts are split 90% to the trader and 10% to Lucid Trading.

cycle_min_profit.quote: You must earn at least the minimum goal between payout cycles

buffer_balance.quote: The buffer is equal to: Initial Max Loss Limit + $100

window.quote: There is no fixed payout window

on_demand.value: DLL ON only; trading on the account pauses for the rest of that day

news.quote: Allowed on Flex, Pro and Direct

flat_by.value: 16:45 ET Mon-Fri (Lucid auto-closes; not a fail)
flat_by.quote: All positions must be closed by 4:45 PM EST, Monday through Friday

inactivity.what: a trade netting at least $1 profit or loss within 30 calendar days, else the account is permanently deleted
inactivity.quote: not been traded resulting in at least a net profit or loss of 1$ within 30 calendar days

bots.quote: Automated trading systems and trade copiers are permitted

hedging.value: banned, also across accounts, across firms and across correlated assets (ES vs NQ)
hedging.quote: Hedging between different firms or funded platforms

max_accounts.quote: Up to 5 active funded accounts per household or family.

platform.value: UNVERIFIED for LucidPro: NinjaTrader via Tradovate is the plan's assumption (research/writeups/corvette-plan-2026-11-21.md); the pages read only name Tradovate / Rithmic for LucidLive

same_strategy_other_firms.value: UNREAD ('Trade with Integrity' not read): get Lucid's written OK first

price.note: UNVERIFIED: lucidtrading.com returns 403. DLL ON is the cheaper option. Use the owner's real price once he buys (CLAUDE.md).
